name: nature34_main_grid_partial_restoration_migration_v1
scope: Bounded migration validation only; frozen build faults and N0; no RL training or formal holdout numerical access

migration_selection.fault_selection_order: Original line natural numeric order within build; exclude default migration fault IDs from extra fault selection
migration_selection.extra_topology_order: Descending number of main-source reachable buses, then ascending little-endian action_index
migration_selection.deduplication_key: Canonical fault_lines, switch_bits, executed_load_bits; preserve every duplicate request and its original case ID in the plan

algorithm_semantics.1: OpenDSS Newton; same engine, not an independent solver

budget_semantics: Count explicit Python Solve and one embedded Solve per compile; not nonlinear iterations. Record actual commands and report any difference; no unbudgeted retries.
line_rating_source_conditions: IEEE feeder34.zip config.xls A5:E9 mapped to testfeeders.pdf page 2 Table 3 column 6 Ampacity at 50 degrees C; this label is not site ambient temperature or an emergency rating
selection_rule: For a fixed case, retain every alpha/algorithm/repetition outcome; a grid witness requires AC audit and known constraints under both algorithms/repetitions. No continuous optimum or method superiority claim.
explicit_model_boundaries: Only sourcebus-connected component is energized; every original scenario and nominal demand remains in accounting, including unsupplied components
No island GFM voltage sources; dead-component DER, load, capacitor and PD elements are disabled, including their controls
Open/faulted boundary PD elements are wholly isolated, removing open-stub charging; this is an explicit numerical-model extension, not original-code reproduction
All four enabled DERs follow common P=alpha*P0 and Q=alpha*Q0 at author pf=0.85; installed/available power and disabled capacity remain separately recorded
Author SubXF25000kVA differs from canonical IEEE2500kVA; this migration retains the author stiff-source numerical setting and does not claim an IEEE hardware nameplate
Author single-phase regulator transformer20000kVA settings are retained; CT100A is not adopted as a thermal rating
Added ties inherit configuration301 conductor ampacity as a declared extension; switching hardware ampacity is not known
Neutral hardware ampacity, delta internal phase winding S, DER Q/S hardware capability, transients and protection coordination are not modeled
All supplied phase voltages use0.90-1.10pu hard checks in this named extension; source1.05pu and load vminpu0.85 model-switch thresholds remain author inputs
Graph supports include all forests before device deactivation and do not establish phase, voltage, thermal or AC feasibility
Finite common alpha grid is a dispatch validation baseline, not continuous AC OPF or an exclusive RL safety advantage
